extracted.intended_audience: organizations and individuals preparing sustainability, non-financial or integrated ESG reports; sustainability/reporting professionals and corporate reporters
extracted.subtask_description: Create and publish sustainability (non‑financial) or integrated ESG reports using the GRI Standards, leveraging GRI guidance, tools, sector guidance, interpretations and governance to ensure transparent, comparable and decision‑useful reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the GRI Standards as the reporting framework
rubrics_metrics.description: A flexible framework for creating standalone sustainability or non-financial reports, or integrated ESG reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the GRI Standards as the common global language to assess and report environmental, social and economic impacts; the Standards provide building blocks for transparent reporting and help manage risks, opportunities and strategic decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make reports consistent, comparable and globally applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: GRI’s consistent, comparable and globally-applicable standards have become the world’s most widely-used sustainability reporting standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for consistency and comparability across reporting periods and entities so reports are trusted and useful for stakeholders worldwide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Standards interpretations for reporting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards interpretations — Issued clarifications on reporting requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult issued interpretations to resolve ambiguities in reporting requirements; apply clarifications when preparing disclosures to ensure compliance with the Standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage with Sector Program and Sector Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Sector Program — Find out about reporting within sectors, and our new Sector Standards Program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reporting for a specific sector, use sector-specific guidance/standards to ensure material topics and disclosures reflect sector realities and expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference the Global Sustainability Standards Board (GSSB) governance
rubrics_metrics.description: Global Sustainability Standards Board — GRI’s standard setting activities are governed by the GSSB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware that standards are set and maintained under multi-stakeholder governance; consult governance information to understand standard development and legitimacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the GRI Sustainability Taxonomy for digital classification
rubrics_metrics.description: GRI Sustainability Taxonomy — Developing a digital taxonomy for the GRI Standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt the taxonomy where applicable to enable digital interoperability and structured data reporting aligned to the GRI Standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access translations where needed
rubrics_metrics.description: Translations of the Standards are available in many languages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use officially translated Standards for non-English reporting contexts to ensure accurate application of requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow 'How to use the GRI Standards' guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: How to use the GRI Standards — Make the most of the leading global standards for impact reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the How to use guidance to understand concepts, reporting processes, materiality, disclosure selection and other practical steps for producing a report aligned to GRI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Get started with reporting using GRI resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Get started with reporting — One-stop-shop for information and ideas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New reporters should use the 'get started' resources to learn initial steps, identify material topics, and plan a first GRI-aligned report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the Resource center to find Standards and supporting documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Resource center — Find and download Standards, guidance, supporting documents and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Download the Standards and supporting guidance to ensure the report uses current requirements and recommended practices; keep copies of relevant supporting documents for auditability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Register your published sustainability report
rubrics_metrics.description: Register your report — Register your published sustainability report here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registering reports increases transparency and discoverability; follow the registration process after publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seek reporting support and training to build capacity
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting support — Gain sustainability reporting expertise with our reporting support; Education — GRI offers services that support sustainability reporters; Newly enhanced GRI Professional Certification Program — GRI's flagship professional training curriculum has been restructured to reflect the latest global trends in the reporting landscape.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use training, certification and reporting support services to build internal capacity, stay current on trends, and produce higher-quality, decision-useful reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use reporting tools and services to improve reporting quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting tools — Premium tools for better sustainability reporting; Services — GRI offers services that support sustainability reporters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt available tools and paid services where appropriate to streamline data collection, disclosure selection, and improve presentation and comparability of reported information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Join the GRI Community and partner networks
rubrics_metrics.description: Join our membership program - drive corporate transparency and contribute to GRI's mission; Member and commercial partner directory — Explore our extended network of commercial partners who support the use of the GRI Standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Membership and partner engagement can provide access to community expertise, services and collaborative opportunities that support reporting quality and uptake.

rubrics_metrics.name: Align reporting with global frameworks and capital market needs
rubrics_metrics.description: Global alignment — How the Standards link to other frameworks and initiatives; Capital markets — Our interaction and partnerships with investors, regulators and stock exchanges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Map GRI disclosures to other frameworks and investor/regulatory expectations to increase decision‑usefulness for capital market stakeholders and to meet multiple external requirements efficiently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report impacts on sustainable development and public policy engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Sustainable development — How to report your impacts on sustainable development; Public policy — Working with partners, markets and policymakers to advance sustainable development; Legislation and regulation — How we are working with political and regulatory stakeholders around the world to promote mandatory disclosures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame disclosures to show contribution to sustainable development goals and be aware of evolving regulatory/legislative contexts; engage with public policy directions where relevant to reporting obligations and stakeholder expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain visibility on news, events and updates from GRI
rubrics_metrics.description: News center — Access the latest stories, press releases and features about sustainability reporting; Events — Upcoming events, webinars and speaking engagements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor GRI news and events to stay informed about standards updates, mappings (e.g., GRI-CDP), webinars, and other guidance that affect reporting practice and expectations.
